annotations.title: Look up identifiers in your reference data

description: Look up BICs (BIC8 or BIC11), national clearing codes (sort codes, ABA, IFSC, CNAPS, ...) and LEIs in the user's own reference files, read locally: SWIFTRef BIC Directory and Payments Directory folders (IDENTIFIERS, including historical, PARTICIPANTS and RELATIONSHIPS files; layouts come from the STRUCTURES file), legacy SWIFTRef products (BIC Plus, BIC Directory 2018, Bank Directory Plus, IBAN Plus, SEPA routing, Reach Plus, gpi), or a CSV/TSV export from any provider or in-house system. Returns per identifier: directory records (name, town, country, current or expired, successor), national IDs linked to a BIC, service participation, and SSI relationship counts with masked accounts. Only matching records are returned. No reference data ships with the plugin.

as_of.description: Date for current or expired, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

column_map.description: For a CSV/TSV whose headers are not recognised: map fields to header names, for example {"id": "Swift Code", "name": "Bank"}. Fields: id, idType, name, town, country, status, modification, start, stop, successor, linkedBic, service, participant, reach.

ids.description: Identifiers to look up, up to 50 per call.

path.description: The reference data: a folder (for example an unzipped SWIFTRef download) or one file. Defaults to the PAYMENT_INTELLIGENCE_REFERENCE_PATH setting.

name: lookup_reference_data
